assertions.assertion: The claim is for Cardiac Event Monitoring
The denial was issued under Reason Code CO-97
CO-97 indicates the service was bundled into another covered procedure
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's condition
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation corresponds to diagnosis code I48.0
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
Syncope corresponds to diagnosis code R55
The patient's episodes are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
The study is intended to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The study is intended to determine the etiology of the collapse
Reconsideration of the CO-97 determination is requested
